title: Filtered colimits of flat modules are flat
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I$ a small filtered category (for instance a nonempty directed set) and $i\mapsto M_i$ a functor from $I$ to the category of $R$-modules, with transition maps $M(a):M_i\to M_j$ for $a:i\to j$, such that every $M_i$ is a flat $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Let $(M,(\mu_i:M_i\to M)_i)$ be a colimit of this diagram in the category of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then $M$ is a flat $R$-module.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 05UT (lemma-colimit-flat), line 8660: a directed colimit of flat $R$-modules is flat; proof by commutation of tensor products with colimits and exactness of directed colimits

proof.text: Raise the module universe from v to max(u,v) using ModuleCat.uliftFunctor. This functor preserves these filtered colimits: compose with the forgetful functor to types, use preservation of filtered colimits by the module forgetful functor and preservation of all colimits by the type ULift functor, and reflect colimits using the larger module forgetful functor. Restrict scalars along ULift.ringEquiv : ULift R ≃+* R, an equivalence of module categories preserving colimits. Reindex along the equivalence AsSmall I -> I, making the index category small in max(u,v). This gives a colimit presentation P of ULift(colimit F) over ULift R in the same universe.

Each lifted stage is flat over the lifted ring by Module.Flat.ulift_left_iff and the flatness instance for ULift of a module. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-colimit-presentation-same-universe] to P. Transfer the conclusion back first across the ring lift by Module.Flat.ulift_left_iff, then across the module lift by Module.Flat.ulift_right_iff. This proves the original statement with both universes unchanged.

split_report.summary: Mathlib re-searched with LeanSearch, Loogle, LeanFinder and grep: no theorem that a direct limit or filtered colimit of flat modules is flat (only direct sums, Module.Flat.directSum); not a leaf. Statement made precise: the vague 'filtered (directed) system' became a functor from a small filtered category (the citer lem-weil-pbc-henselization-flat-quotients applies it to the filtered category of etale algebras of lem-weil-pbc-pair-henselization, not a directed set), with def-weil-pbc-category-colimit added to stmt_deps. Proof follows Stacks 05UT in three steps: reduce flatness to injectivity of 1_M (x) u by symmetry of tensor; tensor commutes with colimits (lem-weil-pbc-tensor-commutes-with-colimits, Mathlib leaf) so 1_M (x) u is the colimit of the injective maps 1_{M_i} (x) u; injectivity of a filtered colimit of injections (the case 0->P->Q of Stacks 00DB) written out from the elementwise description lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-modules-elementwise (Mathlib leaf), which holds for filtered categories, so no reduction to directed sets (Categories 04AX) is needed. No new nodes.
